<!--Do not add the category "Imperial Army platoons" to this article. The article belongs to the Legends continuity, meaning Negastrike platoon, a Stormtrooper platoon within the 501st Legion, is NOT part of the Imperial Army, due to the Stormtrooper Corps in Legends being considered a wholly separate branch of the Imperial Military from both the Imperial Army and the Imperial Navy.-->
'''Negastrike platoon''' was a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which had conducted operations on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Lasan/Legends|Lasan]], and the [[Metellos Ring]]. Their most notable operation, however, had been the [[Battle on Doshan]]. The unit was composed of several [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]] and [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|Incinerator stormtroopers]], alongside standard [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
